subject: Routing and authority for MSA + Order Form execution
body:
From: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@brightwell.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@brightwell.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jan 2028 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: MSA/Order Form final routing: signer confirmation and clean copies

Hi Naomi —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We received the redlined MSA and the Order Form from your team and want to move to execution this week. A few quick asks before we start the DocuSign envelope:

- Can you confirm who at Redwood will be the signing authority for the MSA (name + title)?
- BrightWell will sign with Tina Park (Dir. Procurement) on our side, but our legal requires a CFO-level signoff for the liability clause exceptions. Does Redwood require executive (CEO/CFO) execution for that redline set?
- We need a final clean PDF and an audit-ready copy (PDF/A) delivered after signing to procurement@brightwell.com and to our S3 (we can provide a presigned folder).

I've attached the latest redlines and our internal signing matrix. If you can confirm routing preference (sequential vs parallel) and who at Redwood will countersign, we'll generate the DocuSign envelope link and provision signers.

Best,
Sam
Sam Jenkins
Procurement Lead, BrightWell Health
Attachments: BrightWell_Redlines_MSA_v2.docx (redlines), BW_Signing_Matrix.xlsx

------------------------------

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@brightwell.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jan 2028 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA/Order Form final routing: signer confirmation and clean copies

Looping in Legal and Sales Ops to confirm authority and the DocuSign plan. Quick summary of our side:

- Proposed Redwood signers: Karthik (Commercial Lead) will countersign the Order Form; Redwood requires VP/CFO sign-off for MSA exceptions — Laura, can you confirm who should execute?
- We prefer sequential signing (Redwood -> BrightWell) for the liability change so our legal can confirm executed copy before counterparty signature, but we can accommodate parallel if procurement needs it.
- Post-sign: request S3 delivery and internal clean copy to Contracts (contracts@redwood.ai) + customer for audit. Marissa, can you prepare the envelope template and make sure the MSA and Order Form are in the same envelope with linking (so the Order Form auto-tags to the MSA)?

Thanks — Naomi

------------------------------

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@brightwell.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jan 2028 14:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA/Order Form final routing: signer confirmation and clean copies

Naomi / team —

I reviewed the redlines and have the following guidance:

1) Signer authority: because BrightWell is insisting on CFO-level signoff for the liability carve-out, Redwood will need an executive-level signature on the MSA. Our current policy permits the CFO (Marcus Lin) or CEO (Avery Johnson) to execute where liability amendments exceed standard thresholds. For speed, Marcus is available to sign this week (I have confirmation from Finance).

2) Routing recommendation: sequential; have Redwood execute first (Marcus), then BrightWell signs. That gives us a clean executed MSA to attach to the Order Form. If BrightWell requires their signature first for procurement reasons, we can do parallel but request immediate delivery of the executed MSA back to contracts@redwood.ai for review before onboarding.

3) Attachments / audit copy: request that DocuSign produce a certificate of completion + PDF/A. After envelope completes, Marissa please push: (a) final signed PDF to BrightWell procurement email, (b) signed PDFs (MSA + Order Form) to our secure contracts S3 bucket, and (c) a copy to the deal record in HubSpot (link in thread).

4) Minor redline responses: I accepted the majority of the edits in the attached clean MSA (Redwood_MSA_v3_clean.pdf). Please review the two unresolved clauses: Indemnity section (clause 7.2) and Data Retention (exhibit B). I flagged these in the clean PDF.

Laura Bennett
VP, Legal Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v3_clean.pdf

------------------------------

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@brightwell.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA/Order Form final routing: signer confirmation and clean copies

Thanks everyone — operational notes and next steps from Sales Ops: 

- I'll create a single DocuSign envelope with two documents (MSA v3 clean + Order Form). Envelope will be set to sequential: Redwood signer (Marcus Lin, CFO) -> BrightWell procurement (Tina Park) -> BrightWell exec (if required). If BrightWell indicates they need Tina and CFO in parallel, we can change to parallel routing but that will remove our ability to verify the MSA before their onboarding request submits.
- I will create recipient roles and require ID verification only on BrightWell's procurement signer (Tina) per their request.
- Post-exec delivery: we'll set up a webhook to push the signed PDFs and the DocuSign certificate to a preconfigured S3 presigned folder. Sam — can you confirm the S3 path or send credentials for the presigned POST?
- I'll include a completed SigningMatrix.xlsx (attached) in the envelope as a reference but not as an executed document.

Targeting to send the envelope Tuesday morning 1/16.

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachments: SigningMatrix.xlsx

------------------------------

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@brightwell.com>, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Jan 2028 08:44:00 -0800
Subject: Final routing plan and DocuSign envelope

Sam — we appreciate the quick turnaround. Per legal, Redwood will have Marcus Lin (CFO) execute the MSA. Proposed routing: sequential, Redwood (Marcus) -> BrightWell (Tina Park). If BrightWell requires additional exec countersignature (CFO/CEO), please provide the name and email and we'll add them as an optional signer (routing position after Tina).

DocuSign envelope provisional link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC12345 (will be sent from marissa@redwood.ai).

Post-sign: Marissa will push final PDFs and certificate of completion to the S3 path you provide; she'll also update the HubSpot deal RW-2028-BW-0912 with the signed docs.

Let me know if any of the above needs to change and we'll send the envelope.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Commercial Lead — Redwood Inference

------------------------------

From: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@brightwell.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Jan 2028 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final routing plan and DocuSign envelope

Perfect — we can accept sequential with Redwood first. Confirming Tina Park will sign for BrightWell procurement (tina.park@brightwell.com). We will not require additional exec countersign right now; procurement has discretion and Tina will cover initial execution.

S3 delivery: Please put the signed PDFs at s3://brightwell-signatures/RW-2028-BW-0912/ (we will monitor a presigned upload). Also send the PDF/A and certificate to procurement@brightwell.com.

One small request: can Redwood also produce a flattened, stamped PDF (page footer with "Executed on YYYY-MM-DD by [signer]") in the artifacts pushed to S3? Our audit team requests a stamped executed copy for long-term retention.

Once the envelope is live, reply-all with the DocuSign notification so we can track.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Jenkins
Procurement Lead, BrightWell Health
